analyzed_vuln.description: sp_exch performs three whole-struct memcpy operations using size values derived from mutable fields (a->used / b->used). After copying b into a, it uses MP_INT_SIZEOF(a->used) for the final copy back into b, but a->used has already been overwritten with b->used. The temporary buffer t was only allocated for the original a->used size, so the last XMEMCPY can read past t (and/or write past b) when b->used > original a->used, causing the ASan heap-buffer-overflow read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when cryptofuzz Set::Run selects mp_exch (case 2) with two sp_int values having different used lengths, specifically where second operand has larger used than first. Data flow: fuzz input -> OpBignumCalc -> wolfCrypt_bignum::Set::Run -> mp_exch/sp_exch. sp_exch allocates temp based on initial a->used, then updates a from b and incorrectly reuses updated a->used for final copy size, leading to OOB access.
